messages:
Priya (Product): Quick capture from today's all-hands sec segment. Customers want a short, shareable summary on BYOK rotation guarantees, HSM support for Private, DSAR ownership, and ISO evidence timing. Can we consolidate here?
Leah (Head of Security): I'll summarize briefly.
Leah (Head of Security): BYOK/KMS: Private & Dedicated support customer-managed keys. We recommend 90d rotations; we don't enforce forced rewraps. We will offer an opt-in managed rotation service for customers who want automation.
Kai (Eng-Infra): Tech: Private connects to customer KMS endpoints. For on-prem HSMs we use a KMIP connector agent; HSM GA needs pilot integrations and security checks.
Jordan (CTO): ETA: HSM connector aim = end of Q3, pending 2 pilots in May/June.
Sam (Privacy): DSARs: Hosted API: Redwood retains only request metadata by default; payloads are ephemeral unless customer opts-in to retention. Private/Dedicated: customer is responsible for DSAR responses for data in their environment; Redwood will provide metadata exports and timeboxed assistance in contracts.
Anya (Compliance): ISO/SOC2 evidence: roadmap (soft) 3 June - export templates; August - self-serve evidence bundles; September - auditor-access controls. We'll publish specifics in the compliance docs.
Leah (Head of Security): Immutable logs: we can replicate audit logs to customer buckets (S3/GCS) with versioning. WORM/immutability depends on the target storage features; we'll provide configuration guides.
Priya (Product): Action items?
Leah (Head of Security): 1) BYOK FAQ + one-paragraph DSAR ownership policy (Leah). 2) HSM pilot checklist & signup (Kai). 3) ISO evidence timeline docs (Anya).
Priya (Product): Please file tickets so we can track.
ticket-bot: Created SEC-501 "BYOK FAQ + DSAR policy" and SEC-502 "HSM connector pilot checklist".
Leah (Head of Security): I'll take SEC-501.
Kai (Eng-Infra): I'll take SEC-502 and start pilot outreach.
Anya (Compliance): I'll open SEC-503 for ISO evidence automation and link it here.
Sam (Privacy): Posting short DSAR blurb for customer use: "Hosted: we keep request metadata; request/response content is not stored unless you enable logs. Private/Dedicated: you control data and are responsible for responding to DSARs; Redwood provides export tooling and contract-bound assistance."
Priya (Product): Great. Once drafts are live I'll assemble a customer-facing FAQ bundle. Thanks everyone.
Leah (Head of Security): Closing loop. For NDA-level details route via Legal.
ticket-bot: Updated SEC-501 assigned to Leah, SEC-502 assigned to Kai, SEC-503 pending (Anya).
